messages:
ava: Quick catch from today's onboarding run: sample-app leaked emails and partial JWTs in auth retry logs when RW_LOG_LEVEL=debug. Repro on Node SDK v0.9.5.

diego: can you paste a redacted line?

ava: copied locally: [ERROR] auth.retry id=req-204 token=eyJhbGciOi... user=chris.k@example.com status=401

sara: that's the redaction ordering issue again. our sanitizer runs for http responses but not for Error objects or retry middleware throws.

diego: also saw that streaming/ws handlers don't get the `rw.request_id` Otel attribute. tracer integration only wired for express middleware.

ava: proposal: (1) move redaction into logger adapter so all outputs go through a single sanitizer, (2) add Error-object scrubber to mask emails/jwts/phones before serialization, (3) map header `x-rw-request-id` -> otel attr `rw.request_id` for http/ws/lambda.

sara: config suggestion for sample app README: { "telemetry.redact": true, "telemetry.redact_patterns": ["email","jwt","phone"], "telemetry.request_id_header": "x-rw-request-id", "telemetry.log_level_env": "RW_LOG_LEVEL" }

diego: tests: unit for sanitizer over nested error.stack, integration smoke that triggers auth retry with RW_LOG_LEVEL=info and asserts no email/jwt in captured logs; extra test that span for ws connection contains attribute `rw.request_id`.

ava: please also add RW_SAFE_DEMO=true in demo scripts to force INFO and auto-redact.

telemetry-bot: created issue SDK-telemetry-912 assigned to diego/sara

diego: i'll open a small PR today to patch node-sample-app + logger wrapper. requesting quick review from @sara this afternoon.

sara: can review after lunch. :thumbsup:
